# DubForge 1.6.1 - a Windows installer
DubForge and DubStage now come as a normal Windows program. Download **`DubForge-DisDubs-Setup-1.6.1.exe`** below, run it, and start DubForge from the Start menu. You don't need Python or batch files.

The setup installs just for you, with no admin rights. It brings its own Python, downloads ffmpeg, and lets you add Demucs (vocal separation) and speech recognition (Whisper subtitles) as optional parts. It installs next to an original DubStage, never over it, and uninstalls from *Settings → Apps*.

Windows SmartScreen may warn because the setup isn't code-signed. Choose *More info → Run anyway*.

Already running DubForge from the folder with `Start DubForge.bat`? Nothing changes for you. The in-app update keeps working, and you only need the setup if you want a Start-menu install.
